skill.name: qwen-image-pro
skill.description: Generate and edit images with Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the inference.sh infsh CLI. The skill focuses on text-heavy posters, banners, marketing graphics, style transfer, variations, seeds, and prompt options for precise image output.
skill.summary: Run Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro image generation and editing through inference.sh.
skill.author: tul-sh

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, fenced examples, and documentation URLs, not executable Ruby code. The meaningful risks are the broad Bash permission for infsh and third-party data egress through the image service. No prompt injection text was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Narrow allowed-tools from Bash(infsh *) to specific app run and app sample invocations if the platform supports argument scoping.
Add a clear privacy note that prompts and reference images are sent to inference.sh and the underlying model provider.
Pin related skill or CLI installation references to trusted versions where possible and tell users to verify the source.

static_findings.snippet: > Requires inference.sh CLI (`infsh`). Get installation instructions: `npx skills add inference-sh/s

| `reference_images` | array | Input images for editing (1-3 images) |
| `num_images` | integer | Number of images to generate (1-6) |
| `images` | array | The generated or edited images (PNG format) |
| `output_meta` | object | Metadata with dimensions and count |
3. **Disable prompt_extend**: Set `prompt_extend: false` for precise control
4. **Use negative prompts**: `"blurry text, distorted text, low quality"`

semantic_findings.title: Broad Infsh Command Permission
semantic_findings.description: The front matter grants Bash(infsh *) access. This permits any infsh subcommand when the skill is active, including networked app runs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools entry explicitly uses a wildcard for infsh. The examples show the intended command family, but the permission is broader than those examples.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Prompt and Image Data Egress
semantic_findings.description: The skill is designed to submit prompts and reference image URLs to inference.sh for Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro processing. Sensitive prompts or private image links could leave the user environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation names the external inference.sh service and shows both CLI and Python SDK calls. It also documents reference image URLs as input to the remote model.

content.value_statement: Teams need reliable image generation for posters, banners, and text-heavy designs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Qwen-Image Pro via inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Runs documented infsh commands for Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro image generation.
Shows prompt patterns for posters, banners, logos, and product imagery.
Supports reference image editing with one to three input images.
Explains width, height, seed, watermark, and variation settings.
Provides guidance for precise text rendering and negative prompts.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated inference.sh CLI.
Sends prompts and image references to a third-party image service.
Does not guarantee perfect text spelling or layout in every image.
Does not include local model weights or offline generation.

use_cases.title: Marketing Campaign Graphics
use_cases.description: Marketing teams can draft sale banners, promotional posters, and social assets with specified text and dimensions.

use_cases.title: Brand Concept Exploration
use_cases.description: Designers can compare logo directions, style treatments, and visual variations before polishing final artwork.

use_cases.title: Product Image Prototyping
use_cases.description: Founders can generate product scenes and hero images for early mockups without a full photo shoot.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image using qwen-image-pro: [subject], [style], [background], [mood]. Use one image and default settings.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Text Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a poster with exact text: "[headline]" and "[subtext]". Set size to [width] by [height] and disable prompt extension.

prompt_templates.title: Produce Several Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [number] variations of [concept]. Keep the same composition, use seed [seed], and compare the strongest result.

prompt_templates.title: Edit With References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use reference image 1 for [person or object] and reference image 2 for [style or outfit]. Generate two edited options with clear constraints.

output_examples.input: Request a 1920 by 1080 summer sale banner with SUMMER SALE and 50% OFF.
output_examples.output: A clean banner concept with centered sale text, bright contrast, and negative prompt guidance for sharp lettering.

output_examples.input: Ask for four logo concepts for a coffee shop named Bean and Brew.
output: Four generated logo variations with different typography and icon styles.
A recommendation to compare readability, color, and brand fit.

output_examples.input: Edit two references so a person wears the outfit from another image.
output_examples.output: Two edited image options that preserve the person and apply the referenced outfit style.

best_practices: Quote exact text that must appear in the image.
Set dimensions before generation when the output has fixed placement.
Avoid private prompts or images unless the external service is approved.
anti_patterns: Do not expect prompt extension to preserve exact copy.
Do not send confidential reference images through unapproved accounts.
Do not request many variations before checking one representative result.

faq.question: What does this skill use to generate images?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh infsh CLI to run Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro.

faq.question: Does it work without inference.sh?
faq.answer: No. You need the CLI installed, authenticated, and able to reach the service.

faq.question: Can it create images with readable text?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for text-heavy prompts, but results still need review.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents reference image editing with one to three input images.

faq.question: Is sensitive data safe to include?
faq.answer: Treat prompts and image references as data sent to a third-party service.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
